text:
Both responses report the prices, data increases, effective date, fixed-contract exemption, exit-fee terms and the reason for the change correctly. The difference is in the Classic plan line. Response A says Classic customers are "unchanged this year," which matches the source. Response B says they are "unaffected until their contract ends," which drops the "this year" qualifier and wrongly implies the exemption is permanent. That makes B slightly misleading on a point that matters to a manager.

Response A is also easier to scan, with labelled sections for who is affected, options and reason. Its support line is unnecessary for a manager, and at roughly 120 words it sits right on the "under 120" limit, which is a minor breach. Response B is comfortably under the limit, but its accuracy gap outweighs that.

Verdict: A
